indication_area: Relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma
geography: Worldwide as booked by AbbVie: Total of AbbVie's 'Epkinly' line, footnoted 'Epkinly U.S. revenues reflect profit sharing. International revenues reflect product revenues as well as profit sharing from certain international territories.' Genmab (co-developer) books U.S. and Japan product sales; this series is AbbVie's own reported revenue line, not end-market sales.
moa: CD20 x CD3 bispecific T-cell engaging antibody

approval_evidence.quote: Biologic License Application (BLA) : 761324 Company: GENMAB US, INC. ... EPKINLY EPCORITAMAB-BYSP ... INJECTABLE;SUBCUTANEOUS ... 05/19/2023 ORIG-1 Approval

launch_evidence.quote: In May 2023, AbbVie announced that the FDA approved Epkinly (epcoritamab) as the first and only bispecific antibody to treat adult patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) DLBCL.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2023Q3, one quarter after the May 2023 U.S. approval: AbbVie's first Epkinly line is in the third-quarter 2023 release; the second-quarter 2024 release shows the 2023Q2 comparison only as a percentage.
search_log: Listed every AbbVie (CIK 1551152) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions (all forms); earnings releases are the 8-K filings with item 2.02 from 2013 (exhibit 99.1 'abbv-YYYYMMDDxexhibit991'), each exhibit resolved from index.json; plus every 10-Q and 10-K from 2013. AbbVie's Forms 10-Q and 10-K print none of Duopa/Duodopa, Epkinly, Orilissa or Qulipta on a revenue line; the releases do.

Every table row whose first cell starts with Duopa, Duodopa, Epkinly, Orilissa or Qulipta followed by a figure was extracted (scan.py). The quarter is the first table of the release (three months); value_reported is its Total column (U.S. + Int'l.), printed by AbbVie.
AbbVie prints its own 'Epkinly' net revenue line (U.S., Int'l., Total) from the third-quarter 2023 release; the footnote letter after the name varies (c or d).
Four-quarter sums: 2024 = 146, 2025 = 271 (and 2023Q3 + Q4 = 31), each equal to the full-year Total in that year's fourth-quarter release.
